initiated by eng. Abdallah Mostafa Saada, tested by eng. Ahmed Elsaaedy, 
accepted by eng. Khamis Elsherif : maintenance general director and approved by

items: A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and 
 carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.

Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.
Close the shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge).

Let the pumps cool down to about < 80 C measured 
 at the branches, then seal off the cooling water pipes and close all other 
 supply lines.

The safety department must check the isolation and 
 surrounding the zone of work.

Isolate the pump ( Close the isolating valves ) and drain it as completely as 
 possible.
Disconnect the auxiliary piping ( water cooling ).
Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling liquid, lube oil.

Uncoupling pump from motor and disconnect any safety devices as well as 
 pressure and temperature measuring instrumentation.
Disconnect pump from suction and discharge piping.
Remove the casing adapter frame nuts.
Pull out the complete bearing housing with rotor.

Carry the complete bearing housing with rotor eventually to the workshop to 
 continue dismantling.

All parts ( as bearing ) must be checked prior to assembly and repaired or 
 replaced if necessary .
The steps of assembling are the reverse steps of dismantling.

Check alignment and free rotation by hand of pump and driver 
 shaft

text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the
 equipment major maintenance (P1 
 ), which must be 
 carried out every year which indicated by ( Y1 ) in the little block.
This pump is used to transfer demi 
 water to the auxiliary cooling water tank.
The Pump 
 Technical Data:
Type | Centrifugal Pump | No. of pumps | 2
No. of stages | 1 | Suction 
 press. | 1.5 bar
Power | 4 KW | Discharge 
 press. | 3.8 bar
Capacity | 12 m3/ h | Pumped Liquid | demi water 30 C
R.P.M | 2970 | Shaft Seal | Packing
The first draft 
initiated by eng. Abdallah Mostafa Saada, tested by eng. Ahmed Elsaaedy, 
accepted by eng. Khamis Elsherif : maintenance general director and approved by 
eng. Abd Elmoaty Elrakayby head sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.
This document 
reviewed by eng. Magdey Hegazy, accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC 
inspection & quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality controls head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and 
 carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Shut down the pump.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.
Close the shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge).
Let the pumps cool down to about < 80 C measured 
 at the branches, then seal off the cooling water pipes and close all other 
 supply lines.
The safety department must check the isolation and 
 surrounding the zone of work.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete set of tools.
Crane.
Alignment indicators, filler .
Grease gun.
Cleaning fluid.
Contact cleaner (CRC).
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in serves
Check oil level and viscosity.
Check heat.
Check noise.
Check vibration.
Check foundation.
Check leakage of water.
Check looses of 
 bolts.
Pump out of serves 
(Dismantling)
Disconnect the motor electrically.
Isolate the pump ( Close the isolating valves ) and drain it as completely as 
 possible.
Disconnect the auxiliary piping ( water cooling ).
Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling liquid, lube oil.
Uncoupling pump from motor and disconnect any safety devices as well as 
 pressure and temperature measuring instrumentation.
Disconnect pump from suction and discharge piping.
Remove coupling spacer.
Drain the oil.
Remove the casing adapter frame nuts.
Pull out the complete bearing housing with rotor.
Carry the complete bearing housing with rotor eventually to the workshop to 
 continue dismantling.
Steps of maintenance:
Check rotor
Change the gaskets if necessary.
Change the packing if necessary.
Change the oil if necessary.
All parts ( as bearing ) must be checked prior to assembly and repaired or 
 replaced if necessary .
Assembling
The steps of assembling are the reverse steps of dismantling.
Check alignment and free rotation by hand of pump and driver 
 shaft
